title: Emerald Saver Account: How your savings help the environment
summary: This document explains the Emerald Saver Account’s environmental impact: 10% of the interest you earn is automatically directed to verified carbon offset programs, and reforestation funding plants 3 trees per $10,000 of average monthly balance. It also covers how allocations and tree totals are calculated, and tips to maximize impact by keeping higher balances and the account active.
